# Vendored data attribution

## lid_halftone.inc

The halftone pictures for `rack_fan_lid.scad`, generated by `tools/lid_halftone.py`. The
wood, waves and ripples pictures are generated from math, not from outside data. The
skyline picture comes from OpenStreetMap building footprints and heights for central
Boston (downloaded through the Overpass API by `tools/boston_map.py`), projected into a
perspective view and sampled on the lid's hole lattice. A lid printed with the skyline is
a Produced Work.
